verdict.rationale: Letta's documented memory system is file/text-based (MemFS, memory blocks) with optional keyword/semantic/hybrid search (letta-docs-28, letta-docs-41), not a graph of entities and relationships; a Letta employee explicitly frames its approach as 'primarily text/files based' as an alternative to structured memory graphs (letta-comm-10). No evidence describes entity/relationship modeling or multi-hop graph traversal for memory.
